40022254.author: पदार्थः
40022254.content: कथां the talk, कथयतां while speaking, तेषां of them, जयं victory, च and, आकाङ्क्षतां while desiring, शुभम् auspicious, व्यतीता passed, रजनी the night, शीघ्रं quickly, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः the great-souled one.

40022254.author: Translation
40022254.content: While they were conversing and wishing for an auspicious victory, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.

40022255.author: पदार्थः
40022255.content: ततः then, प्रभाते in the morning, विमले clear, तस्मिन्काले at that time, सः that, राक्षसः demon, निर्गतस्तु indeed came out, पुरात् from the city, धीरः brave, भक्ष्याहारप्रचोदितः impelled by the desire for food.

40022255.author: Translation
40022255.content: Then, in that clear morning, the brave demon, impelled by his hunger for food, came out of the city.

40022256.author: पदार्थः
40022256.content: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime, वीरः the brave, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, यमुनां Yamuna, नदीम् river, तीर्त्वा having crossed, मधुपुरद्वारि at the gate of Madhupura, धनुष्पाणिः with bow in hand, अतिष्ठत stood.

40022256.author: Translation
40022256.content: In the meantime, the brave Shatrughna, having crossed the Yamuna river, stood at the gate of Madhupura with his bow in hand.

40022257.author: पदार्थः
40022257.content: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे midday, प्राप्ते having arrived, क्रूरकर्मा cruel-deeded, सः that, राक्षसः demon, आगच्छत् came, बहुसाहस्रं many thousands, प्राणिनां of living beings, भारम् burden, उद्वहन् carrying.

40022257.author: Translation
40022257.content: Then, as midday arrived, that cruel demon came, carrying the burden of many thousands of living beings.

40022258.author: पदार्थः
40022258.content: ततः then, ददर्श he saw, शत्रुघ्नं Shatrughna, स्थितं standing, द्वारि at the gate, धृतायुधम् holding a weapon, तम् to him, उवाच said, ततः then, रक्षः the demon, किम् what, अनेन with this, करिष्यसि will you do.

40022258.author: Translation
40022258.content: Then he saw Shatrughna standing at the gate, holding a weapon, and the demon then asked him, "What will you do with this?"

40022259.author: पदार्थः
40022259.content: ईदृशानां of such (like you), सहस्राणि thousands, सायुधानां armed, नराधम O vilest of men, भक्षितानि have been devoured, मया by me, रोषात् out of anger, कालम् death, आकाङ्क्षसे do you desire, नु indeed, किम् what.

40022259.author: Translation
40022259.content: "O vilest of men, I have devoured thousands of armed individuals like you out of anger; do you indeed desire death?"

40022260.author: पदार्थः
40022260.content: आहारश्च food and, अस्य his, सम्पूर्णो complete, ममायं my this, पुरुषाधम O vilest of men, स्वयम् by himself, प्रविष्टो entered, अद्य today, मुखं mouth, कथमासाद्य how having reached, दुर्मते O evil-minded one

40022260.author: Translation
40022260.content: The demon, addressing Shatrughna, exclaims that Shatrughna, the vilest and evil-minded of men, has today entered his mouth by himself, thus becoming his complete meal.

40022261.author: पदार्थः
40022261.content: तस्य his, एवम् thus, भाषमाणस्य while speaking, हसतश्च while laughing and, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, वीर्यसम्पन्नो endowed with valor, रोषात् from anger, अश्रूण्यवासृजत् shed tears

40022261.author: Translation
40022261.content: As the demon spoke thus and laughed repeatedly, the valiant Shatrughna shed tears out of intense anger.

40022262.author: पदार्थः
40022262.content: तस्य his, रोषाभिभूतस्य overcome by anger, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, तेजोमया radiant, मरीच्यस्तु rays indeed, सर्वगात्रैः from all limbs, विनिष्पतन् burst forth

40022262.author: Translation
40022262.content: From the great-souled Shatrughna, who was overcome by such rage, radiant rays of light emanated from all his limbs.

40022263.author: पदार्थः
40022263.content: उवाच spoke, च and, सुसङ्क्रुद्धः very much enraged, शत्रुघ्नस्तं Shatrughna to him, निशाचरम् to the night-wanderer, योद्धुमिच्छामि I wish to fight, दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, द्वन्द्वयुद्धं single combat, त्वया with you, सह together

40022263.author: Translation
40022263.content: And Shatrughna, greatly enraged, spoke to that demon, declaring his wish to engage in single combat with the evil-minded one.

40022264.author: पदार्थः
40022264.content: पुत्रो son, दशरथस्याहं of Dasharatha I, भ्राता brother, रामस्य of Rama, धीमतः the wise, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, नित्यशत्रुघ्नो the eternal slayer of enemies, वधाकाङ्क्षी desirous of killing, तवागतः your has come

40022264.author: Translation
40022264.content: I am Shatrughna, the son of Dasharatha and brother of the wise Rama, the eternal slayer of enemies, and I have come here desiring your death.

40022265.author: पदार्थः
40022265.content: तस्य मे for me, युद्धकामस्य desirous of battle, द्वन्द्वयुद्धं a single combat, प्रदीयताम् let it be given. शत्रुस्त्वं you are an enemy, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, न not, मे from me, जीवन् alive, गमिष्यसि you will go.

40022265.author: Translation
40022265.content: Grant me, who desires battle, a single combat, for you are an enemy to all beings, and you shall not escape me alive.

40022266.author: पदार्थः
40022266.content: तस्मिंस्तथा when he thus, ब्रुवाणे was speaking, तु indeed, राक्षसः the demon, प्रहसन्निव as if laughing, प्रत्युवाच replied, नरश्रेष्ठं to the best of men, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तो ऽसि you have arrived, दुर्मते O evil-minded one.

40022266.author: Translation
40022266.content: As he spoke thus, the demon, as if laughing, replied to the best of men, "Fortunately, O evil-minded one, you have arrived!"

40022267.author: पदार्थः
40022267.content: मम my, मातृष्वसुर्भ्राता mother's sister's brother (maternal uncle), रावणो Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of demons, हतो was killed, रामेण by Rama, दुर्बुद्धे O foolish one, स्त्रीहेतोः for the sake of a woman, पुरुषाधम O lowest of men.

40022267.author: Translation
40022267.content: O foolish one, O lowest of men, my maternal uncle Ravana, the lord of demons, was killed by Rama for the sake of a woman.

40022268.author: पदार्थः
40022268.content: तच्च and that, सर्वं all, मया by me, क्षान्तं was tolerated, रावणस्य Ravana's, कुलक्षयम् destruction of the lineage. अवज्ञां disrespect, पुरतः first, कृत्वा having made, मया by me, यूयं you all, विशेषतः especially.

40022268.author: Translation
40022268.content: I tolerated all that, the destruction of Ravana's lineage, but I have especially shown contempt towards you all from the very beginning.

40022269.author: पदार्थः
40022269.content: निहताश्च and killed, हि indeed, मे by me, सर्वे all, परिभूतास्तृणं insulted like grass, यथा as. भूताश्चैव and those who were (past), भविष्याश्च and those who will be (future), यूयं you all, च and, पुरुषाधमाः O lowest of men.

40022269.author: Translation
40022269.content: Indeed, all of them, past, present, and future, including you, O lowest of men, have been killed and insulted by me as if they were mere grass.

40022270.author: पदार्थः
40022270.content: तस्य to that, ते your, युद्धकामस्य one desirous of battle, युद्धं battle, दास्यामि I will give, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, तिष्ठं stand, त्वं you, च and, मुहूर्तं for a moment, तु indeed, यावत् until, आयुधम् weapon, आनये I bring, ईप्सितं desired, यादृशं of what kind, तुभ्यं for you, सज्जये I prepare, यावत् until, आयुधम् weapon

40022270.author: Translation
40022270.content: O evil-minded one, I will give you the battle you desire; just wait for a moment until I bring and prepare the kind of weapon you wish for.

40022271.author: पदार्थः
40022271.content: तम् to him, उवाच said, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, क्व where, मे from me, जीवन् alive, गमिष्यसि will you go, शत्रुः an enemy, यदृच्छया by chance, दृष्टः seen, न not, मोक्तव्यः to be released, कृतात्मना by a resolute person

40022271.author: Translation
40022271.content: Shatrughna quickly said to him, "Where will you go alive from me? An enemy, once seen by chance, should not be released by a resolute person."

40022272.author: पदार्थः
40022272.content: यः who, हि indeed, विक्लवया confused, बुद्ध्या with intellect, प्रसरं opportunity, शत्रवे to the enemy, ददौ gave, सः he, हतः is killed, मन्दबुद्धित्वात् due to dull-wittedness, यथा just as, कापुरुषः a coward, तथा so

40022272.author: Translation
40022272.content: Indeed, whoever gives an advantage to an enemy with a wavering mind is killed due to his dull-wittedness, just like a coward.

40022273.author: पदार्थः
40022273.content: तस्मात् therefore, सुदृष्टं well-seen, कुरु make, जीवलोकं the world of living beings, शरैः with arrows, शितैः sharp, त्वां you, विविधैः various, नयामि I will lead, यमस्य of Yama, गेहाभिमुखं towards the house, हि indeed, पापं sinful, रिपुं enemy, त्रिलोकस्य of the three worlds, च and, राघवस्य of Rama

40022273.author: Translation
40022273.content: Therefore, take a good look at the world of the living, for I shall lead you, a sinful enemy of the three worlds and of Rama, towards Yama's abode with various sharp arrows. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टषष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 68 ।। Thus ends the sixty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
